Consequence of Sound — May 23, 2013

Watch Caveman's horrifying video for "In The City" starring Julia Stiles

By Alex Young · Consequence of Sound

From that screen-grab Caveman's new music video doesn't look like a total nightmare, but you know the best horror movies always start with some unsuspecting rubes.

Julia Stiles (10 Things I Hate About You), Fran Kranz (Dollhouse), and Michael Cavadias star in a short film set to Caveman's "In The City" from the band's self-titled sophomore album. Stiles and Kranz's trip to the Big Apple takes a creepy turn when the couple checks into small hotel with a bellhop whose skin-crawling fetish will forever make you check behind the curtains in every hotel you ever stay in again. Watch the Lynchian video below, directed by Philip Di Fiore.
